# Load Libraries and Datasets
```{r}
rm(list=ls())
library(dplyr)
library(readxl)
library(readr)
library(tidyr)
library(gt)
library(sf)
library(tigris)
access <- read_csv("data/10th Percentile Access Tracts.csv")
prscrb <- read_csv("data/Providers with Geographic Location.csv")
tracts <- read_csv("data/2024 Census Tracts.csv")
```

# Clean combined CMS/Prscrb Dataset
```{r}
prscrbr_sf <- prscrb %>%
  filter(!is.na(latitude) | !is.na(longitude)) %>%
  st_as_sf(
    coords = c("longitude", "latitude"),
    crs = 4326)

prscrb %>% filter(is.na(latitude) | is.na(longitude))
```
